description: Source code for a Mem0 memory node implementation in a chat application, including class definition, initialization, and chat message management.

classes.name: Mem0_Memory
classes.description: Implements a chat memory node using Mem0 service, managing user IDs, chat history, and message retrieval.

classes.name: Mem0MemoryExtended
classes.description: Extends BaseMem0Memory to handle user ID logic, chat message loading, and context management with Mem0.

methods.name: initializeMem0
methods.description: Initializes Mem0 memory with configuration and user ID handling.

methods.name: getEffectiveUserId
methods.description: Determines the effective user ID based on toggle and input.

methods.name: loadMemoryVariables
methods.description: Loads memory variables, including chat history.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from database and optionally prepends system message.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Adds chat messages to memory and database.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Clears chat messages from memory and database.
